newsitem.title: USA: MEDIQ extends tender for notes.
newsitem.headline: MEDIQ extends tender for notes.

text.p: MEDIQ Inc said on Friday that its MEDIQ/PRN Life Support unit has extended, until September 30, 1996, the expiration date of its cash tender offer to purchase all of its 12-1/8 percent senior secured notes due 1999.
The company is buyin them at $1,078.78 per $1,000 in principal.

The outstanding principal balance of the Notes is $100 million of which about $98.2 million had tendered through September 26, 1996, the company said. The offer was set to expire on September 27, the company had said.
